AI HOSTS & AGENTS
MCP clients live in the host/agent runtime

MCP CLIENT LAYER
Discovery, request construction, normalization

ENTERPRISE MCP GATEWAY
Central policy, authentication, routing & audit

REMOTE MCP SERVERS
Google-managed or enterprise-hosted endpoints

ENTERPRISE TOOLS & DATA
Systems reached through MCP tools/resources

Gemini Enterprise / Gemini App
Enterprise AI experience hosting MCP-capable clients where supported

Vertex AI Agent Engine
Managed production agent runtime

ADK / Custom Agents
Agent Development Kit or custom host

IDE / Developer Assistants
Developer tools with remote MCP client support

Enterprise Applications
Business apps embedding MCP-enabled agents

Tool Discovery & Registry
list_tools / capabilities and endpoint configuration

Capability Cache & Metadata
Client-side capability metadata; do not centralize conversational state here

MCP / JSON-RPC Request Builder
Streamable HTTP request construction and transport handling

Response Normalization
Normalize tool results/errors into the host runtime

Client-Owned Session Context
Conversation/session context remains with the host/client by default

Cloud Run Gateway Service / Optional Enterprise API Front Door
Authenticated HTTPS entry; preserve MCP Streamable HTTP semantics

OAuth / OIDC Authentication
Validate client identity and token audience; use supported MCP authorization patterns

IAM / Workload Identity Federation
Google Cloud IAM and federated workload identity for authorized callers

Policy / Tool Allowlist
Authorize server, tool, tenant, environment and action scope

Tenant / Tool Authorization
Least privilege and resource-level authorization before invocation

Rate Limits / Quotas / Backpressure
Protect endpoints; handle retries, timeouts and overload deliberately

Model Armor / Content Inspection
Optional prompt/tool-call/response protection where supported or explicitly integrated

Request Routing & Orchestration
Route only to approved remote MCP endpoints; preserve protocol errors

Protocol / Header Management + Audit
Correlation IDs, safe headers, structured logs and audit evidence

Google / Google Cloud Remote MCP
Managed MCP endpoints where available

Database MCP Server
Enterprise-controlled data access facade

GitHub / DevOps MCP Server
Repository, CI/CD and issue/tool access

Enterprise SaaS MCP Servers
Salesforce, ServiceNow, SAP or approved SaaS endpoints

Custom MCP Servers on Cloud Run
Authenticated remote MCP services using HTTP/Streamable HTTP

Other Approved MCP Endpoints
Regional/global endpoints registered through enterprise governance

BigQuery / Analytics
Governed analytical queries and metadata

AlloyDB / Cloud SQL / Databases
Transactional and relational tools through least-privilege interfaces

Cloud Storage / Content Repositories
Objects, documents and governed enterprise content

GitHub / DevOps Platforms
Code, pull requests, issues and pipelines

Salesforce / ServiceNow / SAP
Business systems exposed only through approved tools

Google Cloud APIs & Enterprise Apps
Managed APIs and custom internal business capabilities

STATELESS, STREAMABLE HTTP REQUEST / RESPONSE
Gateway nodes should not become a server-side memory store.

CROSS-CUTTING GOVERNANCE & OPERATIONS
Apply across hosts, clients, gateway, servers and downstream tools

IAM & Least Privilege
Caller, server and downstream resource authorization

Model Armor / Safety
Supported MCP sanitization or explicit custom integration

Secret Manager / KMS
Credential and secret material stays out of prompts and logs

Cloud Logging & Audit
Invocation, policy decision, tool result status and correlation

Cloud Monitoring & Alerting
Latency, errors, availability, saturation and abuse signals

Organization Policy / Guardrails
Approved endpoints, projects, regions and data-boundary controls

Retries / Timeouts / Circuit Breakers
Bounded retries and resilient failure handling
